item.title: Government backs Milburn report on new welfare system for young people
item.body: Ministers have promised an entirely new welfare system for young people after backing Alan Milburn's 278-page report. They promised spending cuts next year to help pay for the proposals. The prime minister called it a 'watershed moment'.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 👥 Government backs Milburn report on new welfare system for young people

Ministers have promised an entirely new welfare system for young people after backing Alan Milburn's 278-page report. They promised spending cuts next year to help pay for the proposals. The prime minister called it a 'watershed moment'.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 17 November, 15:51
